story.purpose: Re-express the station colour script so every district withholds by showing rather than by hiding. The visit means exactly what it meant before; what changes is that a player can read the room it happens in. A room you can read is still allowed to be cold; a room you cannot read is a bug.
story.emotionalBefore: A visitor in a place that will not show itself: the hall is a black void, the far portals are indistinguishable from wall, and the only room with light is the only room that seems to exist.
story.emotionalAfter: A visitor in a place that shows exactly how much of it there is and how little of it is for him: extent as coldness, flatness as unkindness, and one room, the concourse, that still comes down to his height.
story.intendedAmbiguity: Whether the station is indifferent or merely built for someone else stays open. The station is never the actor: nothing here explains the sealed volume, names the place, or has a fitting notice the player.
nonNegotiableCanon: The district colour script stays a sequence: cold, clinical, warm, coldest-hue, sodium. It may be re-exposed; it may not be flattened into one uniform brightness.
The concourse is the only room that likes you and stays the fill peak; its DISTRICT_FILL entry is unchanged.
The station is never the actor. No light notices the player; light cardinality never changes around a player verb.
The three station objective ids, marker labels, reaches, gates and work-order lines are shipped protected copy and change by not one word.
The hall and the warehouse stay unnamed; no station proper name is coined; ISSUING STATION stays where it already lives.
The standalone sandbox stays ephemeral and non-canon.
The interior stays two instanced draws on one material and one program.

revealLedger.playerEvidence: This revision adds no story information and spends no hidden-pillar budget. Every new visible element is light: fill, albedo, fog, emissive trim, and HUD chrome. framing.blocking: screen right reads as deeper into the station

screenDirection.axis: the station spine, apron to counter to concourse to hall to shelves
screenDirection.movement: screen right reads as deeper into the station

lens.easing: none — FOV is constant and player owned

physicalIntent.character: The shipped station FOV 75 with near 0.08 and far 4000 is the whole lens contract; no physical lens model is claimed and none is introduced.

physicalIntent.shutterMotionIntent: None. No motion blur, no shutter simulation; the only motion in frame is the player’s own.

motion.easing: none — the camera is never driven
motion.target: whatever the player is looking at

motion.collisionPlan: Shipped first-person collision is unchanged by this run.

cues.phraseIntent: One unbroken silence from the first interior frame to departure. No cue, no stinger, no objective-entry tone, no acknowledgement of any player verb.
cues.mixIntent: There is no bus. Nothing is ducked, nothing is prioritised, because nothing sounds.
cues.silenceIntent: The Score Director declines every cue for this revision and signs it as no-cue-by-contract. The classification, recorded here so a future run inherits a decision rather than an accident: the station’s silence is UNSPENT INVENTORY, not a protected baseline. Nobody composed it; audio dies at the page swap. A future run may score the station without a broken-silence objection, provided it goes through the deferred station-audio packet rather than a polish lock. Two anchors are pre-identified for that packet: concourse-open, where warmth you did not make would be the first pitched material since the dock, and concourse-leave, its withdrawal. Score under this pass would blur which sense is doing the work while Cinematography is being measured on luminance.

score.mixIntent: No mix exists. The only audio requirement of this run is proof that none is created: zero AudioContext, webkitAudioContext and OfflineAudioContext constructions and zero HTMLMediaElement play calls on the station page.
score.performancePlan: No nodes, no voices, no per-frame audio work, no soak. The verifier check runs in the baseline-probe.mjs idiom against http://127.0.0.1:4321 with the Paravoxia title identity check: instrument the three context constructors and media play, teleport apron to counter to concourse to floor to shelves, click for pointer lock, open and close a vendor panel, and step each story objective id change, expecting a count of zero at every sample and window.__voxSfxDiag undefined at every sample. A console error naming AudioContext is a failure. Run before and after implementation; both must be zero. No combined-bus render, because there is no bus.

performance.measurementPlan: The stable, comparable numbers on this renderer are programs, meshes, instances and visibleCellCount, read from the shipped SandboxHud diagnostics in the hud=1 pass. Shader programs is an ABSOLUTE budget: 13, the measured baseline, unchanged, because the interior surface stays one material and one program and the new fittings are instances of the two existing draws. Draw calls is a baseline-plus-two ceiling: the measured baseline is 3 meshes (interior surface, interior lamps, crowd) and the plan is plus zero, with two of headroom granted by the lock. GPU memory is a delta ceiling of 4 MB: no texture exists or is added, and the change is roughly 60 additional instanced boxes per district plus two scalars. Instance parity is asserted per district against evidence/baseline-perf.json, with the added-instance count declared and bounded at plus 80 per district. FPS and frame time are ADVISORY ONLY: SwiftShader measured 0.6 to 3.3 fps across two baseline runs with no stable ordering between districts, so it is not a usable regression signal at this resolution on this renderer; the 60 and 30 figures are the shipped targets carried forward for triage. A real frame-time judgement requires the headed real-GPU session that is already an open owner gate.

acceptanceCriteria: Per-vantage luma targets hold at 1600 by 900, dpr 1, SwiftShader: hall (07, 08) median 22 to 34 with at most 35 percent under 16; apron (01, 02) median 30 to 42 with at most 25 percent under 16; shelves (09) median 34 to 46 with at most 25 percent under 16; counter (03) median 48 to 62 with at most 10 percent under 16; concourse (04, 05, 06) median 56 to 72 with at most 12 percent under 16; concourse up (06b) median at least 30. No entered-district vantage falls below median 22 or above 35 percent under 16 (the legibility floor), and no vantage exceeds its stated percentage above 235.

The monotonic ordering assertion is printed as pass or fail by the capture harness on every run: median(hall) plus 6 at most median(apron), median(apron) at most median(shelves), median(shelves) at most median(counter), median(counter) at most median(concourse) minus 6; the concourse is the maximum and the hall the minimum; the counter holds the lowest standard deviation and the lowest percentage under 16 of any district.

The hudSurfaces sweep passes: station-story-hud, station-prompt, station-crosshair and the station marker are registered in main/src/ui/hudSurfaces.ts with layer assignments and are swept by main/tools/hud-overlap-sweep.mjs with zero overlaps on desktop 1600 by 900 and on mobile 390 by 844 and 844 by 390. No existing surface id, layer or exemption is changed by lock revision R1.

The T-concourse-open strip asserts, at frames minus 0.5, 0, plus 0.4, plus 0.8, plus 1.2, plus 1.4 and plus 2.0 s from the occupiedCellId change: ramp progress 0 at t equals 0, at least 0.95 at plus 1.2 s and exactly 1.0 at plus 1.4 s; caption computed opacity 0 through plus 0.8 s and 1 at plus 1.2 s with progress at least 0.9; concourse median luma inside its target band at plus 1.4 s; the ramp is monotone with no overshoot at any sample.
Zero console errors across the whole capture sweep, in both the sandbox and the story-mode routes, on desktop and mobile. A console error naming AudioContext is a hard failure of the silence proof.

Instance and program parity: programs is 13 and meshes is 3 at all five districts, point lights are 7, added instances are at most plus 80 per district against evidence/baseline-perf.json, and draw calls are at most baseline plus 2.

Audio silence proof: zero AudioContext, webkitAudioContext and OfflineAudioContext constructions and zero HTMLMediaElement play calls, with window.__voxSfxDiag undefined at every sample, across district teleports, pointer lock, a vendor panel cycle and all three story objective id changes, before and after implementation.

Contrast proof on the mobile still: DIM_INK at 0.68 reaches at least 4.5 to 1 against its own box backdrop over a 70-luma frame, with INK and WARM_INK above it; the 5 by 5 px outlined crosshair remains visible on both the darkest floor and the brightest registry wall.
Crowd legibility: figure versus backdrop delta of at least 0.08 linear at 06-concourse-look. If it fails, SUIT_DARK is darkened; suits are never brightened.

Shipped copy parity: the three objective ids, the three marker labels, the six work-order lines, the three low lines, all reaches and all gates are byte-identical to shipped, proven by diffing spaceStationStory.ts and storyText.ts as unchanged.
